'''Skyreaper drones''', nicknamed '''Skreapers''', were used by the slaver organization [[The Crucible]] to attack settlements and capture slaves for many years prior to [[Mandalorian Wars]]. In [[3963 BBY]] captain [[Dace Golliard]] of the [[Gladiator (Crucible)|''Gladiator'']] used skyreaper drones to detain the ''[[Hot Prospect]]'' in the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]].
